title_en: Alert, watch out for a rockfall on the way to Yala Cave Art site.
summary_en: The 10th October, 2569 reporter reports that the police officer Vichai Boonlao, a volunteer of Cultural Heritage (OS. MSC) under the Department of Arts and Culture at the 11th Division of Art and Culture, has warned about an unexpected rockfall on the way to Yala Cave Art site.
